key_structures: Main Sanctum atop Sahyadri hillock with massive bust of Devi Renuka
special_features: Deity visible as a massive, beautifully adorned natural head/face (Mastaka) emerging from the living bedrock
Pan-Deccan sacred confluence of Shakta, Datta, and Parashurama traditions
Fortified ramparts offering panoramic views across dense deciduous forests
materials: Gold and silver mukut (crowns) and masks
renovation_history: Built during the reign of Seuna Yadava dynasty of Devagiri (around 12th century); fortified and maintained by regional Maratha chieftains.
